item.title: Winc Opens Up: A Rust Editor That Boots in 119 ms - Built for Reviewing AI-Generated Code
item.description: Rust editor Winc hit GitHub on 2026-11-04 (v0.1.452): self-reported 119 ms cold start, 52 MB on a 100k-line file, word-level diff plus built-in terminal, positioned for reviewing AI-written code.

item.title: Ki Editor: Treat Code Like LEGO Blocks
item.description: Ki Editor isn't for writing text—it's for building with blocks. It operates directly on your code's syntax tree (AST), letting your cursor jump between expressions, functions, and entire code blocks. Multi-cursor editing relies on syntax structure, not visual alignment. After using it for a week, I never want to go back to plain text editors.
